title: types: the object-form subforms[].columns mirror is z.array(z.any()); objectstack now judges that key as InlineGridColumnSchema — follow at the next @objectstack/spec bump
body:
Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`) as the objectui coordination child of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20901. That card's Direction for site 1 says "objectui's mirror follows at its next pin bump". ⛔ This is not a claim. Reader: objectui triage first, then the `domain:ui` seat.

## What changed upstream

objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20927 landed as `bee75cebe6`.
- In `@objectstack/spec`, `FormViewSchema.subforms[].columns` changed from `z.array(z.any())` to `z.array(InlineGridColumnSchema)`: the same strict schema object that `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` exports. It carries a Clause-② narrowing and a `minor` changeset.
- `defineStack` also refuses an identity-only column that carries `scale` when its `name` resolves, through `childObject`, to a `currency` field.
- It ships in the next `@objectstack/spec` release. At filing, no published version carries it.

## The site here (objectui `origin/main` `54a78308a3`)

- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:640`, the `object-form` `subforms[]` item: `columns: z.array(z.any()).optional()`.
- `packages/types/package.json` depends on `@objectstack/spec` `^17.5.0`.
- Until the mirror follows, `objectui validate` accepts a `subforms[].columns` entry with a bogus key, and a typed `currency` column with `scale`, both of which `os validate` now refuses. #20901's body measured this against objectui#11238's head.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Once the spec dependency carries the release with `bee75cebe6`, the mirror should reference (or derive from) the spec's `InlineGridColumnSchema` instead of `z.any()`. The render-time report from objectui#11238 remains the backstop for the hydrated currency case.

## Dedupe

The seat scanned the open objectui issues for `subforms` + `columns` and for `InlineGridColumn`. That found only the seat post #9771 and the unmirrored-keys ledger #6152. Neither covers this key's narrowing.
